risks.risk: Region/variant mismatch (seller says UK; buyer needs to know if it’s actually UK/region-correct for power/plug and any bundle expectations).
risks.proof: Photo of the console serial/label sticker (back/bottom) showing region/model details, plus a photo of the power plug/cable label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS5 bundle with one controller, without assuming UK receipt/region-specific extras.

risks.risk: Console may have faults not visible in photos (e.g., HDMI port, disc drive issues, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, overheating under load).
risks.proof: Video/clip of: console boot to home screen, Wi‑Fi connection, controller pairing, and a short game/app launch; plus a quick check that HDMI displays correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case 'not fully verified working' (i.e., treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Controller condition/compatibility (drift, dead buttons, charging issues).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing controller connected and working: analog movement test, button presses, and charging indicator (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller may be imperfect (worst-case: assume it needs testing).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/receipt (seller claims UK receipt and original pads/accessories).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (console, controller, cables, any receipt/box/inserts) with receipts clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming receipt/extra accessories are included.

risks.risk: ‘Never opened or repaired’ could be false; internal repairs can affect reliability.
risks.proof: Photo of warranty seals/inspection stickers (if any) and a clear shot of screw heads/edges; ideally a short explanation plus close-up photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially previously serviced (worst-case reliability).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console serial/model label (back/bottom) and the power cable/plug.
Video clip: boot to PS5 home screen + connect to Wi‑Fi + controller pairing + launch a game/app for a few minutes.
Video clip showing HDMI output working and that all visible ports are functional (USB ports at least).
Photos of the full bundle laid out (all cables, controller, any receipt/box/inserts) with the receipt text readable.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5-style console and one controller, but key pricing drivers (exact variant/region, full working status of ports/disc drive, controller health, and whether receipt/accessories are included) are not verifiable from the images. Request proof before pricing.
